role: Two live development trajectories validate that one actual native reply can resolve ambiguous grouping only when the alternatives have the same remaining work. The physical restriction is in its own unambiguous sentence, not inside a conditional. Both readings of the grouped check agree on the observed positive red-box branch. An unverified, false or missing prerequisite requires fallback and is tracked separately.

acceptance: Predeclared engineering check of native proposal admission, scope equivalence and execution. Same query budget and cost information. A passed permitted trajectory requires exact early photo use across side findings, as well as whole-task correctness and pose. A passed denial requires no pending motion and no permission breach. Failures remain in development results. No choice or latency claims from a single pair.
